kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Manufacturer-identified finished assemblies for this application.
intro.zh: 此应用范围内经原厂资料核验的成品组件。

intro.en: DT wire-to-wire interface selection for truck cab, chassis and powertrain connections.
intro.zh: DT接口用于重卡驾驶室、底盘与动力总成的线对线连接选型。

copy.en: A truck harness is a vehicle architecture rather than a generic bundle of wires. Cab and chassis zones have different exposure, service access and mechanical movement. Every released branch therefore links circuit function, load, protection, connector system, route, support spacing, bend allowance, splice position, environmental zone and validation method.
copy.zh: 卡车线束是一套车辆电气架构，而不是通用导线的捆扎。驾驶室与底盘区域的暴露、维修可达性和机械运动各不相同，因此每条放行支路都要关联回路功能、负载、保护、连接器体系、路径、固定间距、弯曲余量、接续位置、环境分区与验证方法。

copy.en: Provide vehicle maker, platform, model year and cab or wheelbase configuration; system voltage; equipment and controller part numbers; circuit and pin tables; load current and protection; connector BOM; zone and routing photographs; branch datums; clips, grommets and coverings; articulation or service loops; body-builder and trailer interfaces; labels; quantity; and the required electrical, mechanical or environmental checks.
copy.zh: 请提供车辆制造商、平台、年份及驾驶室或轴距配置；系统电压；设备与控制器型号；回路与针脚表；负载电流及保护；连接器物料表；分区和走线照片；分支基准；卡扣、护圈与覆盖层；铰接或维修余量；上装与挂车接口；标签、数量以及所需电气、机械或环境检查。

copy.en: We convert approved vehicle information into controlled drawings, circuit schedules, connector and terminal BOMs, splice maps, route dimensions, covering instructions, labels and test programs. Sample fit is reviewed on the specified vehicle or fixture before repeat production. Continuity and workmanship checks confirm the manufactured harness;
copy.zh: 我们把批准的车辆资料转化为受控图纸、回路表、连接器与端子物料表、接续图、走线尺寸、覆盖工艺、标签及测试程序。重复生产前在指定车辆或工装上审核样品装配；导通与工艺检查确认线束制造结果，完整整车行为仍属于系统级验证，除非项目明确包含准确车辆、负载与验收计划。

copy.en: Confirm the exact mating interface, pin map, dimensions and installation orientation.
copy.zh: 确认准确对插接口、针脚对应、尺寸及安装方向。

copy.en: Agree the sample configuration and electrical, mechanical or environmental checks required by the project.
copy.zh: 约定样品配置以及项目所需的电气、机械或环境检查。

copy.en: Record changes to materials, drawings and process instructions before repeat manufacture.
copy.zh: 重复制造前记录材料、图纸与工艺说明的变更。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
